title: VirtualBox virtual machines
whyItMatters: A virtual machine folder contains a whole second computer: settings, virtual disks and snapshots. It can hold data no other rule will see.
source: Oracle VirtualBox User Guide, default machine folder $HOME/VirtualBox VMs - https://www.virtualbox.org/manual/ch10.html
notes: Default machine folder only. Unconfirmed: a custom Default Machine Folder changed in VirtualBox preferences is not matched. Virtual disks are counted by size, never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Export each machine you still need to an appliance, or copy its disk files, before deleting anything here.
steps: Open VirtualBox and remove the machines you no longer need, choosing Delete all files.
Uninstall VirtualBox from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the virtual machine folder named in the plan if anything is left.
cleanup.risk: Deletes the virtual machines on this PC, including their disks and snapshots. Files inside a machine cannot be recovered once it is deleted.
cleanup.source: Oracle, Oracle VM VirtualBox User Manual: https://www.virtualbox.org/manual/
